pages.text: $(o)Forts, temples, towers, ruins and wrecked ships across the Wildlands. Dungeon level 3 or 4, higher in the Frontier.$()$(br2)$(l)Counter:$() The walls will not break. Take the door and clear room by room.$(br2)Some are $(l)Armored$(), $(l)Magebane$() or $(l)Bounty$() dungeons. The zone line tells you which; see World & Danger.
